en: Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a large fortified complex with high walls, a prominent round tower and a long palace-like building behind it. Trees and a broad walkway with a few pedestrians appear in the foreground. The bottom margin bears a printed caption identifying the castle and handwritten script; there is also a vertical strip of handwriting on the right edge.
